generation.scope: In the maximal-tangent finite window branch, a plane graph or an irreducible cuspidal cubic graph is impossible. An integral nodal graph gives exactly two types, each a projective eight-space with a linear codimension-two subspace removed, modulo a finite group. Generic periods are two and four. Every finite window with one of the quantum, transverse line-conic cyclic or nodal boundary bases in the theorem is a flat specialization from the smooth elliptic family of matching order, with all mixed coefficients lifted.
